purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Maara Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered at 250 DPI directly from a freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (4-page form; page 3 of 4 carries the final shaded TOTAL row, immediately followed by two blank pages before the signature page). No third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact was used. The PDF has no embedded text layer (confirmed by direct extraction attempt), so all values were read visually from the rendered page image, cross-checked against a tight high-DPI crop isolating just the TOTAL row band.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image, then independently cross-confirmed with a separately rendered high-DPI crop of the same row (scripts/p23/crop_page.py). No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

note: This evidence establishes a source-verified row under the extraction contract. Canonical materialization is authorized only by the separate governed promotion tranche in data/p23/form34b-turnout-promotion-contract.json.
